signals.name: BLE_RemPwrOnOffReq
signals.valueDesc:
0x0: Invalid 待机
0x1: Power on 上电（至远端Ready状态）
0x2: Power off 下电
0x3: 上Ready
0x4: 下Ready

signals.name: BLE_ReqtPolicyInfo
signals.valueDesc:
0x0: None
0x1:开始
0x2:暂停
0x3:恢复
0x4:返回原位置
0x5:结束

signals.name: BLE_ParkDirSel
signals.valueDesc:
0x0: None
0x1: ParallelLeft
0x2: ParallelRight
0x3: PerpendicularForward
0x4: PerpendicularLeftForward
0x5: PerpendicularRightForward
0x6: PerpendicularLeftBack
0x7: PerpendicularRightBack
0x8: PerpendicularBack

signals.name: BLE_RpaRemDrvgReq
signals.valueDesc:
0x0: 待机
0x1: 前进
0x2: 后退
0x3: 左转
0x4: 右转
0x5: 前进左转
0x6: 前进右转
0x7: 后退左转
0x8: 后退右转
0x9: 转向回正
